patches.name: Android XR compatibility
patches.description: Makes Steam Link fully functional on Samsung Galaxy XR. Adds Android XR / OpenXR permissions and features, HMD and controller identity configs, Galaxy XR bridge native libraries, safe permission handling, the launcher bootstrap, and managed-panel aspect correction with XR spatial-pointer button input. This patch is required for Galaxy XR operation.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app package so it can be installed alongside the original Steam Link. Default appends '.gxr'. Changing the package name may break features that rely on the original identity.

options.title: Package name
options.description: New package name, e.g. com.valvesoftware.steamlink.gxr. Leave 'Default' to append '.gxr' automatically.

patches.name: Controller velocity fix
patches.description: Experimental: derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history, avoiding delayed runtime velocity during throws.

options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)
options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.

options.title: Derived velocity smoothing
options.description: Previous-output weight. 0 gives minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.

options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)
options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.

options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)
options.description: Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.

patches.name: Device identity
patches.description: Overrides the HMD manufacturer/model identity reported to SteamVR (hmd_config.json only; controller identity is unaffected). 'samsung-default' leaves the file untouched.

options.title: HMD identity
options.description: Which HMD identity to report to SteamVR.

patches.name: GXR face bridge
patches.description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest.

patches.name: HMD-only pose fix
patches.description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths.

targets.description: HMD-only pose fix layout verified for versionCode 5001712.

options.title: Pose offset (ms)
options.description: Milliseconds added to HMD pose-query time. Tested default: 78 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.

patches.name: OLED color calibration
patches.description: Replaces VRLink's embedded GLSL fragment shader with configurable Galaxy XR OLED gamma and saturation correction.

options.title: Calibration profile
options.description: Tested profiles: Initial uses gamma 1.06 and saturation 1.12; Final balanced uses gamma 1.20 and saturation 1.45. Custom uses number inputs below.

options.title: Gamma
options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.06 (Initial) and 1.20 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.

options.title: Saturation
options.description: Used by Custom profile. Tested values: 1.12 (Initial) and 1.45 (Final balanced). Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.

patches.name: Video dither
patches.description: Enables (or disables) the dormant GLSL dither term in VRLink's video fragment shader. Reduces 8-bit contouring on OLED displays.

options.title: Enable dither
options.description: True to uncomment the dither line; false to recomment it.
